description: This file defines the EmployeeEventService class in the OrangeHRM project, providing methods for managing employee events such as creation, updating, and retrieval. It interacts with data access objects and uses traits for common utilities.

classes.name: EmployeeEventService
classes.description: Provides services for managing employee-related events, such as saving new events, updating employee details, and retrieving events based on filters.

methods.name: getEmployeeEventDao
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the EmployeeEventDao instance.

methods.name: saveEmployeeEvent
methods.description: Persist an EmployeeEvent object to the database.

methods.name: saveEvent
methods.description: Creates and saves a new EmployeeEvent with provided details.

methods.name: getEmployeeEvents
methods.description: Retrieves employee events based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Retrieves the role of the current user, defaults to 'System' if unavailable.

methods.name: saveAddEmployeeEvent
methods.description: Saves an event indicating an employee was added.

methods.name: saveUpdateEmployeePersonalDetailsEvent
methods.description: Saves an event indicating the employee's personal details were updated.

methods.name: saveUpdateJobDetailsEvent
methods.description: Saves an event indicating the employee's job details were updated.
